# Sustira

> Danish sustainablity consultancy based in Silkeborg, Denmark. We help small and medium sized companies understand and implement sustainable initiatives through work with ESG and LCA reports. Founded by Mie L. Kristensen.

## Core Services

- **ESG reports**: Oversight and documentation for your sustainable practices
- **LCA calculations**: Calculations to ease decisionmaking
- **Science based target initiative**: From 2-hour demos to 10 ECTS university modules (IDA Learning, EADania, SmartLearning)
- **Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment**: Practical security analysis for features, services, and architectures
- **Compliance Support**: IEC 62443, ISO 27001, GDPR - implemented in practice, not just on paper

## Industries

Critical infrastructure, energy, finance, cloud/SaaS, manufacturing, maritime, public sector.

## Location

Silkeborg, Denmark. Works with clients throughout Denmark.

## Community

Active in OWASP Aarhus, BSides Aarhus, DevOps Meetup Aarhus, .NET Meetup Aarhus, AWS Meetup Aarhus.
